title: Sailing regatta brings together cadets and alumni
summary: The traditional regatta took place in Novorossiysk waters with crews from the university and alumni of different years.

body.text: The university’s traditional sailing regatta took place in the waters of Novorossiysk, with cadets, teachers and alumni competing.
Winners received cups and commemorative medals. The next regatta is planned for spring 2027.
